coordinate_system.chunk_centre_ue_m: UE metres X north, Y east, Z up; mesh origin == chunk centre; FBX is exported centred so UE actor location (cm) = centre_ue_m * 100

uv_channels.UV0: (u 0..1 across the mesh width, v = s/10)
uv_channels.UV1: (lateral metres from centre line, right +; arc length s in metres)
uv_channels.UV2: (paved half width m, lane width m); (0, 3) on junction pads = no markings
uv_channels.UV3: (median width m, zone: 1 carriageway, .66 shoulder, .5 curb / pavement, .33 barrier / parapet, 0 skirt)
